serveReturn.title: Deep serve and return targets
serveReturn.description: Place three targets in the final third of the service boxes. Alternate serves and returns, recording how many of 20 land deep without missing.

thirdShot.title: Third-shot plus fifth-shot progression
thirdShot.description: Hit a third-shot drop, move forward, then play the fifth ball. Score the repetition only when both shots remain unattackable.

kitchen.title: Dink placement ladder
kitchen.description: Start with ten neutral dinks, then target wide, middle and backhand zones. Restart whenever the ball becomes attackable.

defence.title: Transition reset and block drill
defence.description: Begin in the transition zone while a partner applies controlled pressure. Reset three balls before advancing, then finish with compact kitchen blocks.

attack.title: Speed-up and counter patterns
attack.description: Practise one disguised speed-up followed by the expected counter. Focus on compact preparation and deliberate body or middle targets.

strategy.title: Pattern-based conditioned games
strategy.description: Play half-court or full-court games with one tactical goal, such as moving the opponent wide before attacking the middle.

consistency.title: Pressure scoring challenge
consistency.description: Complete a skill target at 8–8 scoring. Restart the sequence after an unforced error to practise maintaining technique under consequence.

performance.title: Structured competitive review
performance.description: Play games against slightly stronger opponents and record rally outcomes, missed patterns and which skills break down first.
